subject.title: [Bug]: Windows gateway listens but local health/status time out after Telegram polling stall (v2026.5.20)

question: Should this Windows Telegram stall class escalate beyond channel/session recovery into gateway process or supervisor restart when local health/status RPC remains timed out?
rationale: Source shows bounded channel recovery and shallow health probes, but choosing process-level escalation versus narrower channel/session fixes changes operator behavior and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep canonical and require recovery policy
options.body: Keep #86031 open, collect affected-host current-main proof, and decide the escalation boundary before queueing a broad fix.

options.title: Close after narrower fixes land
options.body: Treat #70024, #80362, #86752, and #90516 as sufficient owners only if maintainers accept that no broader gateway responsiveness item is needed.

options.title: Add immediate supervisor restart
options.body: Implement a hard gateway restart/watchdog path now, accepting the operator-impact and upgrade behavior as product policy.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical and require recovery policy
recommendation.body: Keep #86031 open, collect affected-host current-main proof, and decide the escalation boundary before queueing a broad fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged gateway recovery work is the closest current-main ownership signal for the unresolved escalation boundary.
